description: FDA food, supplement and cosmetic adverse events — Search FDA CAERS adverse event reports for foods, dietary supplements and cosmetics by product or brand, industry or reaction, with an optional since date: total reports, outcome counts (hospitalization, ER visit, death...), top reported reactions, and the newest reports with reactions, outcomes, consumer age and gender and the products involved.
